excluded_reason: frozen annotation eligibility failure or fewer than 5 evaluated non-target Reactome signature genes; see excluded_drugs.tsv
metric: per drug-cell rank superiority AUC after removing all annotated known targets; equal average across contexts
matched_gene_strata: 8-quantile Reactome annotation burden x 8-quantile PPI degree; exact within-set counts
rank_aware_matched_gene_strata: Primary strata plus 4-quantile global mean normalized rank, averaged equally across cell contexts per drug and then equally across drugs
annotation_source: rank-blind Reactome signatures frozen before score inspection
interpretation: Known-target-anchored functional concordance of ranked candidates; not target engagement, pathway activity, new-target validation or causal mechanism.
